ecommerce.title: E-commerce Store
ecommerce.description: Full-featured online shop with product catalog, categories, search, shopping cart, and user authentication.
bullets: Dynamic routing by category and product, with persistent cart and accounts via localStorage
Custom image carousel and horizontal promotions scroller built from scratch
Product data fetched from an external API with loading and error states

hub.title: Productivity Hub
hub.description: All-in-one app combining notes, an alarm system with sound and notifications, a task tracker, and an AI-powered tarot reader.
bullets: Real-time alarm checker triggering audio playback and browser Notifications
Integrated an LLM API (OpenRouter) for mystical, context-aware interpretations
State persisted to localStorage across three independent feature modules

thoughts.title: True Thoughts
thoughts.description: Full-stack MERN app for anonymously publishing short thoughts, with a decoupled frontend and backend.
bullets: Designed a REST API (Node.js/Express) integrated with MongoDB Atlas
Deployed on Vercel using Serverless Functions
Card-based storage view with formatted timestamps and delete functionality

vin.title: VIN Decoder
vin.description: Utility app for decoding Vehicle Identification Numbers using the official NHTSA API.
bullets: Client-side VIN validation with regex before hitting the API
Search history saved to localStorage with quick-access buttons
Separate page listing all decodable vehicle variables
